Before implementing the roadmap, define and test the supported Beads setup matrix for hermes-beads.

- bd v1.0.4 uses Dolt as the only supported backend; legacy SQLite is removed.
- Standard embedded Dolt setup works with installed hermes-beads v1.0.1.
- Stealth embedded Dolt setup works with installed hermes-beads v1.0.1.

- standard embedded Dolt repo
- stealth repo
- nested cwd auto-discovery
- repo initialized from JSONL export
- repo with Dolt remote configured but not necessarily reachable
- server/shared-server mode, if feasible locally
- unsupported/global/readonly cases and expected failure modes

Implementation requirements:
- Add a compatibility matrix document before behavior changes.
- Add automated smoke tests for cheap local modes.
- Clearly mark unsupported topologies instead of pretending universal support.
- Do not read or write `.beads/issues.jsonl` as source of truth; use bd CLI/Dolt for operations.
- Keep outputs public-safe.

title: hermes-beads v2.0.0: Dashboard plugin with visual bead graph
description:
# Hermes-Beads v2.0.0 — Dashboard Plugin Plan

> **Status:** Draft  
> **Date:** 2026-06-17  
> **Author:** Hermes Agent (deepseek-v4-pro)  
> **Target:** hermes-beads v2.0.0 — pivot from standalone CLI to Hermes Dashboard plugin

---

## 1. Overview

### 1.1 What Changes

hermes-beads v1.x is a standalone Python CLI (`hb`) that wraps the `bd` (beads) task tracker. v2.0.0 becomes a **first-class Hermes plugin** that renders the Beads task graph as a live, visually polished panel inside the Hermes dashboard (port 9119).

**Current:** `pip install hermes-beads` → CLI tool `hb`  
**Target:** Plugin at `~/.hermes/plugins/hermes-beads/` → dashboard page at `/dashboards/beads/`

### 1.2 Why

- Beads is Marian's primary task tracker across all projects
- The dashboard is the single pane of glass for Hermes operations
- A visual bead graph gives instant project state awareness without running CLI commands
- "Sexy popping" design makes it something you *want* to look at

### 1.3 Non-Goals

- Multi-user support (this is a single-user home lab)
- Collaborative editing of beads from the dashboard
- Replacing `bd` CLI — this is read-only visualization + dispatch triggers
- Dolt sync management from the UI

---

## 2. Architecture

### 2.1 Plugin Structure

```
~/.hermes/plugins/hermes-beads/
├── plugin.py                  # Entry point: register routes, static files, tools
├── __init__.py
├── bead_reader.py             # Read beads from .beads/issues.jsonl
├── graph_builder.py           # Build DAG from bead data
├── bead_model.py              # Pydantic models for bead data
├── static/
│   ├── beads.css              # Dashboard page styles
│   └── beads.js               # Frontend: D3/vis-network for graph rendering
├── templates/
│   └── beads.html             # Jinja2 template (or embedded HTML)
├── demo/
│   └── sample_beads.json      # Demo data for when no .beads/ exists
└── SKILL.md                   # Updated skill documentation
```

### 2.2 Data Flow

```
.beads/issues.jsonl (on disk)
    ↓ bead_reader.py (read + parse)
    ↓ bead_model.py (validate with Pydantic)
    ↓ graph_builder.py (build nodes + edges)
    ↓ plugin.py (expose as /api/beads/<project>/graph.json)
    ↓ beads.js (D3/vis-network rendering in browser)
    ↓ Dashboard panel at /dashboards/beads/

User actions (dispatch, close, etc.):
    ↓ beads.js → POST /api/beads/<project>/dispatch
    ↓ plugin.py → call hb bridge dispatch (or direct bd wrapper)
    ↓ Update frontend
```

### 2.3 Route Design

| Route | Method | Purpose |
|-------|--------|---------|
| `/dashboards/beads/` | GET | Main dashboard page (project selector + graph) |
| `/api/beads/projects` | GET | List discovered bead repos |
| `/api/beads/<project>/graph` | GET | Full bead DAG (nodes + edges JSON) |
| `/api/beads/<project>/bead/<id>` | GET | Single bead detail |
| `/api/beads/<project>/ready` | GET | Ready queue |
| `/api/beads/<project>/dispatch` | POST | Dispatch ready beads to Kanban |
| `/api/beads/<project>/gate/<id>/resolve` | POST | Resolve a gate |

### 2.4 Integration Points

- **Hermes dashboard routing:** register routes via Flask blueprint or the Hermes plugin API
- **Static files:** served via Hermes' existing static file handler
- **Tools:** expose `beads_graph`, `beads_ready`, `beads_dispatch` as Hermes tools so the agent can interact with beads from chat
- **Cron:** existing `hb bridge tick` becomes `/api/beads/<project>/tick` called by Hermes cron

---

## 3. Frontend Design

### 3.1 Layout

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Beads Dashboard                        [project ▾] │
├──────────────┬───────────────────────────────────┤
│  Ready Queue │      Task Graph (D3 vis-network)   │
│              │                                    │
│  hb-abc P1   │    ┌───┐                           │
│  hb-def P2   │    │ A │──┐                        │
│  hb-ghi P3   │    └───┘  │    ┌───┐               │
│              │           ├───→│ C │               │
│  [Dispatch]  │    ┌───┐  │    └───┘               │
│              │    │ B │──┘                        │
│  Filters:    │    └───┘                           │
│  ☑ ready     │                                    │
│  ☐ blocked   │  Click node → detail panel →       │
│  ☐ in_progress│                                    │
│  ☐ closed    │                                    │
├──────────────┴───────────────────────────────────┤
│  Detail Panel (collapsed, expands on node click)   │
│  Title: Fix privacy scanner                        │
│  Status: ready | Priority: P1 | Assignee: —       │
│  Dependencies: hb-xyz                              │
│  Description: ...                    [Dispatch]    │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### 3.2 Visual Design

- **Color palette:** Dark background (#1a1a2e or Hermes dashboard theme), with neon accents
- **Node colors by status:**
  - Ready: glowing green (#00ff88 with box-shadow glow)
  - In progress: pulsing amber (#ffaa00, CSS animation pulse)
  - Blocked: muted red (#ff4477 with lock icon)
  - Closed: dimmed gray (#666) with strikethrough or checkmark
- **Edges:** Curved arrows with gradient, animated on hover
- **Transitions:** Nodes fade in on load (staggered), smooth movement on layout changes
- **Typography:** Monospace for IDs, system font for titles
- **Graph layout engine:** vis-network (vis.js) with hierarchical layout for DAG display, or D3 force-directed with constraints for tree-like dependency graphs

### 3.3 Interactions

- **Node click:** Expand detail panel on the right/bottom
- **Node hover:** Highlight dependencies (incoming + outgoing edges)
- **Drag:** Reposition nodes (graph is interactive, not static)
- **Zoom/pan:** Standard graph navigation
- **Dispatch button:** Sends ready bead to Hermes Kanban, updates node color
- **Auto-refresh:** Poll `/api/beads/<project>/graph` every 30s (or use SSE/WebSocket for real-time)

### 3.4 Responsive

- On narrow screens (<768px): stack vertically — ready queue on top, graph below
- Graph takes full available height
- Mobile: simplified list view with expandable detail cards

---
